subject.facility_name: SUMMIT AT PLANTSVILLE CENTER FOR HEALTH & REHABILI

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $175.9 per resident day (44.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 2.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $799,418, 8.9% of the $8,948,858 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,467,901, $28.85 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $759,458 (51.7%), allocated fringe $203,377 (13.9%), non-wage costs $505,066 (34.4%). Raw food was $445,942 ($8.77 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $8,759.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $604,722, $11.89 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $425,698 (70.4%), allocated fringe $113,999 (18.9%), non-wage costs $65,025 (10.8%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $397,376, $7.81 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $230,510 (58.0%), allocated fringe $61,729 (15.5%), non-wage costs $105,137 (26.5%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075420/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
